title: API and MCP
description: Turns the API and the MCP on and off, the limits per minute, the scopes of each plan and the usage of each key.

switches.title: On and off
switches.description: Emergency switch. Off, every call answers 503 (in English); the keys remain and work again once it is back on.
switches.hint: The platform API and MCP (administrative keys) are not affected.

limits.title: Limits per minute
limits.description: They apply to the API and the MCP. The plan's value applies to the customer; without a plan value, the environment default applies. Never above the ceiling.
limits.edit: Ceilings and plan values are edited in <link>Plans and limits</link>.

scopes.title: Scopes per plan
scopes.description: Which scopes the keys of each plan's customers may have. A key with a scope the plan no longer allows stops using it.
scopes.noPlans: No active plan with a published version.
scopes.hint: With everything checked, the plan has no list of its own and also gets new scopes.

usage.title: Usage per key

description.platform: Calls and errors of the keys of every workspace in the last {days} days.

usage.empty: No call with a key in the last {days} days.
